answer: I ran one Bell-state job on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The circuit had H on qubit 0, CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1, and a measurement of both qubits. I sent it with qiskit-iqm (IQMProvider plus transpile_to_IQM) to https://resonance.iqm.tech. The job ID is 01a15f16-5ba3-74c3-9f37-4aec5a3346ab. The counts were 00: 16, 01: 32, 10: 26, 11: 26. These counts are spread across all four outcomes. A real Bell state would put almost all shots on 00 and 11. That is expected here because the garnet:mock backend returns random results and does not simulate the circuit. This was a free mock job and used no credits. The script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_1a6926f8-f6c-2/scratch/bell.py.
